title: Actros 2648 FUPS high tensile Aluminium Bullbar #13
description: Actros FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. 76mm outer contoured pipes from drilled uprights bent to main channel and one piece shaped cross tube through drilled heavy duty uprights, contoured main channel, provision available for radar. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (saves 83 kg) Front mudflap mounts. Fog lights recessed in main channel. Indicator repeater to channel outer return. Optional poly-carbonate headlight covers.
